facts.big: The best bargain I’ve ever found
facts.label: Superlativo + present perfect
facts.sub: Use the + superlativo + I’ve ever + particípio: the best bargain I’ve ever found. Para negar, use never: I’ve never found one.

facts.label: O/A mais…
facts.sub: Use the + adjetivo + -est para palavras curtas: the cheapest, the nicest. Use the most + adjetivo longo: the most interesting, the most expensive. Irregulares: good vira the best, bad vira the worst.

facts.label: Que eu já…
facts.sub: Termine com I’ve ever + particípio: the best bargain I’ve ever found; the nicest bag I’ve ever seen. Ever significa em qualquer momento da vida.

pages.title: A flea market in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Sunday at a market in Dallas. Many stalls sell old and handmade things. Eva has found something special. She carries a lamp in a paper bag. Her friend Cleo meets her near the fruit stand. Cleo sees the bag and smiles.

“Eva, you look so happy! What did you find at the market?” says Cleo. “This is the best bargain I’ve ever found. Look at this old lamp!” says Eva. “It’s beautiful. It’s the most interesting lamp I’ve ever seen.” says Cleo.
